我們的河山
programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampltbrampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.desc: 諜戰劇沉默的榮耀，真實歷史的震撼再現！劇集首次以真實姓名真實事件，將一段幾乎被時代塵埃掩埋的壯烈史詩以電視劇形式再度呈現，劇情跌宕起伏，扣人心弦ampampampltbrampampampgt當所有人享受著革命勝利的果實見證新中國成立的時候，有一群人，放棄了安逸的生活，在白色恐怖的籠罩下，以丹心為炬，照亮了歷史的漫漫長夜39集電視連續劇沉默的榮耀以前所未有的視角，將鏡頭對準了這些在台灣隱蔽戰線上的無名英雄，以深沉細膩的敍事手法，在語言風俗及生活場景中融合閩台文化元素，呈現台灣島在上世紀五十年代的面貌，讓觀眾彷彿穿越回到那個動盪的年代ampampampltbrampampampgt沉默的榮耀根據真實歷史人物吳石朱楓陳寶倉聶曦等烈士的事蹟改編，創作歷時七年，講述1949年至1950年，中共代號｢密使一號｣的台灣國防部中將參謀次長吳石，與中共華東局女情報員朱楓國防部中將陳寶倉副官聶曦等人緊密配合，多次將機密軍情傳遞給共軍，之後遭出賣而被捕吳石在牢房中用鮮血寫下台灣必歸四個大字，四人最終以為中共從事間諜活動被判死刑伏法ampampampltbrampampampgt此劇集結了國劇一線的實力派演員與經驗豐富的幕後團隊由盧敏為總編劇，楊亞洲執導，于和偉吳越魏晨曾黎等領銜主演憑藉強勁的製作班底，頂級演員的精湛演繹，此劇在國內開播後引發廣泛關注9月30日於央視8套開播，首日收視率破3，還曾連續18天創大陸收視第一官方宣傳該劇為獻禮國慶大劇，是新中國成立以來首部反映台灣隱蔽戰線鬥爭的重大主題影視作品

programme.desc: 我們的河山改編自同名小説由劉戈建編劇，毛衛寧執導，王雷陳鈺琪焦俊豔張天陽領銜主演的一套以抗戰為題材的電視劇1937年，抗日烽火燃遍華夏在崮城縣，滿懷熱血的青年共產黨員莊埼風（王雷飾），在其上級領導周密的指導下，深入民間，展開了一場艱鉅的敵後鬥爭他們遵循論持久戰的戰略方針，透過減租減息組織農救會等方式，成功喚醒並團結了廣大群眾，將渙散的力量凝聚成抗日的洪流莊埼風不僅帶領民眾剷除魚肉鄉民的土匪，更組織武裝力量對日偽政權發起有力打擊在八路軍一一五師的支援下，軍民同心，生死相依，逐步建立起穩固的抗日根據地他們在敵人的高壓統治下，憑藉無比的勇氣與智慧，硬是撕開了一道封鎖的裂口，將孤勇化為合力最終，他們成功反擊了日軍的多次掃蕩，徹底擊潰了淪陷區的偽政權，迎來了抗戰的偉大勝利

programme.title: 向風而行
programme.desc: 鷺航客運飛行部副部長顧南亭（王凱飾），以嚴苛自律和鐵血上司的形象深受眾人敬畏與之形成鮮明對比的是貨運女飛行員程霄（譚松韻飾），她性格爽朗不羈，即將晉升機長的她卻因公司改制被降至客運部的觀察員，重新踏上飛行之路命運的玩笑是，顧南亭成了程霄的直屬上司和導師，兩人的相遇註定了不尋常的火花ampampampltbrampampampgt顧南亭習慣於秩序和規章制度，而程霄卻喜歡不按常理出牌，經常讓他應接不暇一系列突發的航空事件接踵而至，要求他們合作應對，但他們的分歧和火藥味卻似乎更加激化了每一場危機顧南亭面對這位性格如此迥異的飛行員，既感到挑戰，也因其勇敢和獨立而歎為觀止在冰火交織的挑戰中，顧南亭和程霄必須找到一種合作的默契，才能化解每一次的險情，確保安全的背後他們的故事不僅僅是師徒間的碰撞，更是對於個性與團隊合作之間微妙平衡的探索

programme.title: 디어 마이 프렌즈
programme.desc: 끝나지 않았다, 살아있다. 황혼기 청춘들의 인생찬가. 어른과 노인의 차이가 대체 뭘까? 이 질문은 이 드라마의 출발점이었다. 본 드라마를 위해, 우리는 청춘들의 어른에 대한 시각을 취재했다. 그들은 가차없이 자신의 윗세대를 어른 아닌 다만 노인으로 폄하하며, 몇몇 부정적 단어로 그들을 규정지었다. 꼰대, 불편, 의무, 부담, 뻔뻔, 외면, 생색, 초라, 구질, 원망, 답답 등등. 사회적 관계에서 만나는 어른은 그렇다 쳐도 부모 조차도 가차 없었다. 말은 완곡했으나 조용히 살아주셨으면 은 공통된 견해였다. 우리는 이런 부정적 시선이 어디서 기인했나 고민했다. 청춘의 인색함일까? 역지사지 못하는 무지일까? 다만 싸가지가 없어서 일까? 우리는 청춘들의 이러한 시각이 어른들에 대한 정보의 부재, 관찰의 부재에서 온 것이라 결론지었다. 어른들이 청춘의 아픔에 갖는 무지 역시 같은 이유일 것이다. 그도 그럴 것이, 드라마 속과 언론 속 시니어는, 참으로 재수 없지 않은가. 돈에 목메고, 남의 자식 상관없고 내 자식에만 목메고, 기존의 질서에 목메고 변화를 두려워하며, 결코 사회적 문제를 약자의 편에서 사고치 않으며사회복지를 노인복지로 국한 지어 규정하는, 사유치 않으며, 젊은이를 경쟁상대로 여기거나 방해하며, 자기만 옳다고 주장하면서 나이로 권력으로 생색내는 자, 끝없이 훈계만을 늘어놓는 지혜 없는 다만 늙은 자. 본 드라마에서 우리는 노인의 이야기가 아닌 어른의 이야기를 하려 한다. 그래서, 제목처럼 청춘과 어른이 친애하는 친구가 되는 관계가 되길 바라는 마음이다.

programme.title: NCIS 시즌8
programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: NCIS 시즌8
programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.title: 大漢盛世完
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 大盛魁
programme.desc: 電視連續劇大盛魁由創業興業歇業三部一百集構成，歷史跨度270年由三個獨立完整的故事構成講述了王相卿張傑史大學等三個赤手空拳創業的故事

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 上陽賦
programme.desc: 皇權腐朽，貴族奢靡，不顧百姓生死郡主王儇，與初戀三皇子子澹青梅竹馬，卻因預言得之得天下，被捲入朝堂爭鬥，成為父親的一顆棋子，嫁給出身寒門的豫章王蕭綦大婚之夜，蕭綦被迫離開京城，王儇蒙羞，心灰意冷賀蘭王子綁走王儇向蕭綦尋仇，夫妻二人因禍得福相知相愛王儇被蕭綦守護天下子民盛世太平的心願感動二人因王謝兩族爭權太后陷害致夫妻流落分離兩人歷經萬苦重聚，滅叛軍，平邊境賀蘭族之亂在叛將謀反時，王儇拼死將無心皇位的子澹護送出京，保他平安王儇帶兵守城，九死一生，終於堅守到邊境平亂的蕭綦趕回最終，夫妻倆攜手開創新紀元，共同守護家國百姓

programme.title: 英雄訣
programme.desc: 燕王朱棣從小就表現出驚人的毅力和膽識，是眾兄弟中最出類拔萃的一個，但因為不是長子而無緣太子位太子朱標意外亡故後，朱元璋立皇孫朱允炆朱棣被削藩逼得無路可退，無奈起兵，在長達四年的靖難之役後，終於入主京師朱棣擁有了天下，卻背上了千古罵名，也失去了心中的摯愛朱棣用後半生的勵精圖治改寫大明的歷史，營建紫禁城，遷都北京，五次親征漠北，編成永樂大典，派遣鄭和下西洋，建立了不朽功績當他最後一次徵北時病逝於凱旋的歸途中

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 遊戲爆報新
programme.desc: 遊戲爆報新

programme.title: 御前夜巡使
programme.desc: 相傳幾百年前，妖邪橫行襲擾宮廷，戍衞王城的夜巡使一職應運而生，名為夜巡實為捉妖！而後天下昇平日久，多年無妖可捉的夜巡使日漸衰敗，初出茅廬的少年燕離可謂血脈僅存然而，突發的連環血案，再次戳破王城夜幕的寧靜十幾名皇室宗親和大臣慘遭屠戮，而始作俑者卻隱藏於迷霧重重的夜幕之中在不斷反轉的正反較量與愛恨糾結中，主人公燕離的命運車輪也隨之開始轉動

programme.title: 非常警察
programme.desc: 年輕女警官希塔晉升警隊隊長，被派至一不良警隊，決心改變隊貌幾次行動連連失手後，遭上司訓斥與冷嘲熱諷，希塔卻沒有一味責怪部下，而是冷靜反省自己，終於感動了隊員再次出任務時，隊員們群情激昂，圍剿匪徒士氣高漲，希塔更冒險假扮人質配合臥底男友阿繼深入匪巢，全隊齊心協力將匪徒一網打盡！

programme.title: 甜蜜殺機
programme.desc: 資深刑警王志毅辦案效率奇差，卻天生有閃避危險任務的神準第六感警察署長的女兒高依萍一心想當警察，擔心愛女安危的署長靈機一動，下令王志毅與她搭檔，兩人水火不容，更被分配到調查可愛小狗死亡這種輕鬆差事沒想到這樁案件竟誤打誤撞，讓兩人追查到了警局通緝要犯的下落，更牽扯出一串驚天動地的謀殺案！

programme.title: 唐山大兄
programme.desc: 青年華僑鄭潮安（李小龍 飾）被母親送往泰國的一間冰廠做苦工謀生；冰廠東主沙密外表為紳士巨富，實為一包娼庇賭之大惡霸在遭受迫害多時後，忍無可忍的鄭潮安與沙密展開生死決鬥，當地政府為紀念鄭潮安為地方除害伸張正義，在公園豎立了銅像，名曰：唐山大兄

programme.title: 東京攻略
programme.desc: Macy結婚當天，日籍新郎高橋裕二失約，她千里迢迢到東京追尋高橋的下落，而為高橋設計新屋的設計師畢大勇，為追討欠款亦跟隨而來兩人闖進高橋的家，遇上正在調查高橋行蹤的私家偵探林貴仁，得悉高橋的失蹤與黑幫首領伊藤武的情人有莫大關係三人雖然都在尋找高橋，但卻有著不一樣的目的，各懷鬼胎可是，隨著黑幫份子及神秘惡勢力不斷滋攘，三人的安全備受威脅

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: 吳家大子吳理（呂方飾）對性感的麥當娜（李麗珍飾）朝思暮想，二女吳采（羅美薇飾）則借故親近表哥強（陳百強飾），小女兒吳姿（關佩琳飾）因小泰龍（柯有倫飾）一次相救而心生傾慕而吳太太（馮寶寶飾）不甘只當家庭主婦，決定參加話劇演員招考，並奇蹟入選劇團女主角，此時，劇團導演（樓南光飾）又對吳太展開追求，讓吳福基醋意大發話劇上映當日，吳家全體竟把話劇台詞當真，引起一陣風波

programme.title: 落跑吧愛情
programme.desc: 嬌氣的千金小姐紛紛（舒淇飾）因逃避家人催促婚姻，帶著母親留下的一捲錄音帶，一路找到澎湖打算體驗歌裡描述的風情迎接她的民宿主人阿武（任賢齊飾），正面臨民宿被弟弟（李國毅飾）抵押投資失敗，民宿因此即將遭查封，這事件令平時深居簡出的民宿大家長（狄龍飾）震怒另一方面，紛紛與阿武一家人連日相處，決定協助阿武一家人讓民宿免被查封於此同時，兩人的愛苗也漸漸滋長

programme.title: 妖貓傳
programme.desc: 故事發生在盛唐時期的長安城，白樂天本是朝廷要官，卻為了收集寫詩的素材而甘願被貶為起居郎長安城內連連發生離奇的死亡事件，就連當今聖上也難逃厄運離奇身亡，這一切都和一隻神出鬼沒的妖貓有關日本僧人空海本為了替皇帝解咒遠渡重洋而來，卻和白樂天意氣相投，兩人決心攜手調查案件真相

programme.title: 綁架者
programme.desc: 一起車禍意外，牽扯出一樁重案組警員林薇（白百何飾）女兒的綁架案，唯一的嫌疑人楊念（黃立行飾）因頭部受到撞擊喪失記憶，面對林薇的步步緊逼與不斷襲來的殺機，陷入迷局的楊念決定挽回自己的記憶隨著楊念重返綁架兒童販賣器官的組織逐漸想起的破碎記憶，他驚覺這一切，竟與追查此案的重案組組長陸然明道飾有著密不可分的關係，而整個警界更有著不可告人的黑暗面而尚未失去記憶前的自己，真實身分又是誰？

programme.title: 出埃及記
programme.desc: 一名女廁偷窺犯不僅矢口否認犯案，更稱在偷窺時無意間發現一個密謀殺光所有男人的女性組織，然而二次偵訊時反大方認罪，負責調查的已婚警官業哥認為事有蹊蹺，且對中途探望嫌犯的女上司起疑，遂決定自行調查不料中途獲報嫌犯意外死亡，束手無策的業哥卻發現一捲影片，記載著組織和妻子的秘密

programme.title: 龍虎風雲
programme.desc: 以南哥及阿虎為首的犯罪集團計劃搶劫某珠寶工場，警方聞訊派出探員高秋卧底偵查高秋順利打入集團內部並參與搶劫行動，成功破案

programme.title: 神機箭
programme.desc: 西元1448年，朝鮮世宗大王時期，為了抵抗前來攻打的中國明朝軍隊，神機箭應運而生韓國人號稱這是世界上最早的連發火箭炮，也是當時火力最強大的兵器，保護整個朝鮮王朝的安全

programme.title: 全境失控
programme.desc: 2030年的日本，支撐人類生活的人工智能希望開發者桐生浩介，帶著女兒重返日本當桐生受到盛大歡迎時，希望卻突然暴走，並開始對民眾展開殺戮搜查官櫻庭一口咬定桐生是幕後黑手，並透過全日本監視網追捕他當日本陷入一片混亂之際，拼死逃亡的桐生能否證明自己的清白，並查出希望的失控原因？

programme.title: 非誠勿擾3
programme.desc: 笑笑答應秦奮求婚後，因追求公益事業離家十年，研究出智慧型機器人的老范為解秦奮相思之苦，設計了一個外表酷似笑笑並植入二人美好回憶的機器人笑笑送給了他在秦奮逐漸深陷AI笑笑的溫柔鄉時，真笑笑突然歸來，兩個笑笑一個敢怒一個敢言，讓秦奮一個頭兩個大，頻頻被虐三人相處笑料與火藥味十足

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: 武功高強的唐龍，受朋友所託遠赴歐洲協助解決一家餐館的業權問題，遇上黑幫搗亂及威迫，並恥笑中國拳術，唐大怒出手把洋人打得抱頭鼠竄，黑幫首領大為震怒，最後請來美國國際空手道冠軍，與唐龍決一死戰

programme.title: 新蜀山劍俠
programme.desc: 西晉五胡之亂時期，各國混戰蜀山，西蜀偵探兵狄明奇誤入血魔禁區，獲南海派劍仙丁引救出狄明奇求丁引收自己為徒遭到拒絕，後遇丁引師弟曉如與徒弟一真，並和峨眉老祖長眉合力鎮魔長眉以法寶昊天鏡鎮住血魔，但曉如被血魔化出魔血附身四人逃出魔窟，前往瑤池仙堡治傷，從而展開一場惡戰

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: 警署即將退休的黃局長因失去佩鎗，懷疑是遭曾到警署參觀的中學生偷走，遂暗中派飛虎隊員周星星（周星馳飾）及老牌臥底曹達華（吳孟達飾）潛入學校臥底伺機尋回失鎗在學校裡假扮父子的兩人與輔導老師何小姐（張敏飾）一班學生及黑社會勢力將會在校園中引起何等風波？

programme.title: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: 周星星（周星馳飾）和曹達華（吳孟達飾）因立功得見上司黃蓮如（葉德嫻飾）研究升職事宜黃對達之正義勇敢極為欣賞，提升為重案組，但對星之輕浮不滿而調往當交通差達獲委以重任再度進入學校臥底調查恐怖分子活動，星亦以個人身份進入學校臥底協助達調查過程中，星發現一女孩Sandy（朱茵飾）可能與此案有關，故假意結識，怎料Sandy竟對星產生愛意，令已與何老師論及婚嫁的星進退兩難

programme.title: 鹿鼎記II神龍教
programme.desc: 龍兒（林青霞飾）重返神龍教繼承教主之職位，並奉命保護平西王吳三桂（秦沛飾）之子吳應熊（湯鎮業飾），前往京城晉見康熙（溫兆倫飾），並在麗春院巧遇韋小寶（周星馳飾）及阿珂（李嘉欣飾）康熙賜婚，命小寶護送建寧公主（邱淑貞飾）下嫁至雲南

programme.title: 掃毒3：人在天涯
programme.desc: 國際販毒集團毒梟康素差一直帶著手下張建行等人從事毒品交易，新加入集團的成員歐志遠也因一次意外，與兩人建立了過命交情，三人情同手足康素差在香港的販毒生意突然被警方查獲，他帶著團隊逃到金三角發展，積極籠絡當地的土皇帝戴金榮，計劃兩人聯手擴大勢力，讓自己東山再起，卻意外發現身邊藏有臥底此刻，是敵是友，一片茫然

programme.title: 變種鯊
programme.desc: 巨鯊來襲，你只是開胃小菜！乘坐水上飛機的五名乘客，在離海岸數英里的地方滯留，原本應該是一次美好旅程，卻變成生命中的噩夢汪洋大海，鯊鰭環視，試圖耗盡倖存者的力氣

programme.title: 普羅旺斯的夏天新
programme.desc: 住在巴黎的三兄妹莉雅安德里和天生失聰的小弟泰歐，被媽媽送到普羅旺斯的外公家過暑假對三兄妹來說外公是個陌生人，既古板又頑固，普羅旺斯和巴黎截然不同的氛圍也讓他們感到格格不入儘管爺孫們在爭執中逐漸感受到彼此的在乎，卻沒想到一次衝突後莉雅憤而離家出走，這個瘋狂的暑假會如何結束呢？

programme.title: 寶藏獵人
programme.desc: 相傳古埃及法老的寶藏，曾在拿破崙遠征埃及時被秘密運回法國時至今日，考古學家克里斯在開羅的一次挖掘中，意外發現一段神秘文字，點燃他的尋寶魂他找上女兒和孫子，三人從羅浮宮查到馬爾梅松城堡的密室在這場關於信念家庭與歷史真相的冒險中，他們能否成功揭開21世紀最偉大寶藏的真相呢？

programme.title: 梵蒂岡：聖杯的考驗
programme.desc: 1943年，一群芬蘭志願者參與了一場由梵蒂岡主教所策劃的尋寶行動隨著旅程深入東方邊境，即將成為神父的米勒考斯基必須判斷這場任務究竟是一場神的召喚抑或是可怕的詛咒

programme.title: 對決
programme.desc: 掌控了戒備森嚴的監獄與內部囚犯，身為犯罪天才同時也是前洛杉磯警局爆破專家的他，將對上兒子也在獄中的退役特種部隊成員兼人質談判專家

programme.title: 終結戰
programme.desc: 一位項上人頭遭到懸賞的年輕美國警察為了替亡師報仇血恨，與一名泰國傭兵聯手合作當他發現自己正與該國最惡名昭彰的冷酷罪犯正面交峰時，他的任務轉瞬之間變得無比凶險

programme.title: 即刻反擊
programme.desc: 美樂莉是個身手矯健的美女特務，她受雇於神秘的地下組織，專門橫越全球執行政府不敢出面的危機任務然而當美樂莉在愛爾蘭執行任務時，身分遭到背叛曝光，成為所有國際間諜的刺殺目標性命危在旦夕的美樂莉，必須運用特務的技巧，逃過重重殺陣返回美國，瓦解遭到滲透的組織與背後的陰謀主使！

programme.title: 波伽利：聲命之歌
programme.desc: 阿莫斯生來就擁有美妙嗓音，卻因為先天性眼疾進入盲人學校，之後又在一場足球比賽意外後完全失明個性好強的他，卻從未因此放棄自己對音樂的熱情與夢想在恩師（安東尼奧班德拉斯飾）的嚴厲指導下，他的歌唱技巧不斷提升與突破，終於獲得義大利國寶級搖滾明星蘇奇洛賞識，親自邀他同台獻唱，此後開始朝史上最成功的跨界男高音之路邁進

programme.title: 可可農莊大冒險
programme.desc: 在單身父親陷入財務困境後，十二歲的麥克斯不得不關閉他在自家車庫裡經營的小買賣，隨父從城裡搬到了村裡，暫時寄住在他姑姑家 在這裡，滿腦子生意經的麥克斯發現了商機，和堂弟查理及當地小網紅愛麗絲一起將一間廢舊的倉庫改造成了養雞棚，養殖注重動物福利的快樂母雞，出售快樂雞蛋，可可農莊誕生了，而且生意興隆好景不長，三個年輕的企業家將面臨一個接一個的挑戰

programme.title: 罪惡對決
programme.desc: 1970年代的愛爾蘭，芬巴墨菲在戰爭後隱居偏遠小鎮，為了擺脫過去，芬巴決心重拾對生活的熱情，同時一個愛爾蘭共和軍小組也來到小鎮藏身，當芬巴發現其同夥曾對當地女孩施暴後，便迫使他在金盆洗手前執行最後一次任務，隨著局勢愈加緊張，芬巴必須在暴露自己祕密身分和保護鎮民之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 星光首映場普羅旺斯的夏天
programme.desc: 住在巴黎的三兄妹莉雅安德里和天生失聰的小弟泰歐，被媽媽送到普羅旺斯的外公家過暑假對三兄妹來說外公是個陌生人，既古板又頑固，普羅旺斯和巴黎截然不同的氛圍也讓他們感到格格不入儘管爺孫們在爭執中逐漸感受到彼此的在乎，卻沒想到一次衝突後莉雅憤而離家出走，這個瘋狂的暑假會如何結束呢？

programme.title: 黑獄戰場
programme.desc: 為了替遭殘忍謀殺的家人復仇，傑克不顧自己警察身分，精心策畫一宗銀行搶案，讓自己被送進兇手巴拉姆所在的監獄但傑克入獄後才發現，巴拉姆早已掌握整座監獄的運作，在牢中享有帝王般的待遇，更受到獄方層層保護，而巴拉姆得知傑克入獄，也派出殺手欲置傑克於死地，正當孤立無援的傑克無計可施之時，FBI臥底威廉提出兩人聯手對抗巴拉姆的計畫究竟威廉真正的意圖為何？傑克又能否殺出重圍，一償復仇宿願？

programme.title: 鬼山
programme.desc: 1989年，當蘇聯即將解體時，一群來自愛沙尼亞的學生到西伯利亞山區，靠近蒙古邊界一帶登山因他們有不同的背景與想法，常常起爭執，很難團結起來某天，在一個非常陡峻的路段發生雪崩，隊長奧雷被淹沒在茫茫大雪裡團員們找不到他，只好繼續前進，到山腳下的布里亞特村尋求救援然而，他們卻被充滿敵意的蘇聯民兵囚禁起來，並捲入了一連串的恐怖事件起初以為是奧雷搞的鬼，直到他們發現奧雷的屍體

programme.title: 超級間諜
programme.desc: 一名迷人的男子在酒吧裡試圖搭訕一名興趣缺缺的女性，他捏造了一個關於間諜晶片植入以及一名正在追捕他的危險科學家的故事但若這一切都是真的呢？真正在搭訕的，又是誰呢？

programme.title: 鬼船瑪麗號
programme.desc: 努力為生活奮鬥的父親（蓋瑞歐德曼飾演），滿懷希望地準備展開租船事業他在拍賣會上購得一艘名為瑪麗號的古船，並興高采烈地帶著妻子（艾蜜莉莫提梅飾演）和兩個女兒出海遊玩乍看歡樂的家庭旅遊，卻因為一連串不可預知的死亡事件，成為一場揮之不去的夢魘究竟，在這片與世隔絕的茫茫大海當中，他該如何保護家人？而瑪麗號又隱藏哪些駭人的詛咒之謎呢？

programme.title: 凜冬謀殺案
programme.desc: 罹患阿茲海默症的患者，到底還是不是原來的那個他？萊恩因整日照顧昏迷中的妻子荒廢了警局的工作某日小鎮傳出罹患阿茲海默症的長者遭到謀殺，而這名嫌疑犯竟然就是衝撞妻子的肇逃車主？究竟兇手謀殺患者們的背後有何意義？而萊恩又能否為妻子討回公道？

programme.title: 36總局
programme.desc: 巴黎街頭出現一群窮凶惡極的匪徒，犯下多起血腥暴力的攻擊事件，警方卻遲遲抓不到兇手警界盛傳只要將這幫惡人緝拿歸案，就能接替巴黎刑警局局長之大位而警局裡最有勝算的兩大警探，里奧為求破案不惜包庇線人，卻意外捲入謀殺案；丹尼則因過於服從上級，導致隊友因公殉職激烈的爭權鬥勢，讓他們兩人迷失在道德邊界，這場權力戰爭將何去何從？

programme.title: 滅證大追殺
programme.desc: 一位在歐洲留學的女大生希瑟偶然發現了一個恐怖組織策劃的謀殺案，她作為主要證人處於生命危險之中

programme.title: 罪惡對決
programme.desc: 1970年代的愛爾蘭，芬巴墨菲在戰爭後隱居偏遠小鎮，為了擺脫過去，芬巴決心重拾對生活的熱情，同時一個愛爾蘭共和軍小組也來到小鎮藏身，當芬巴發現其同夥曾對當地女孩施暴後，便迫使他在金盆洗手前執行最後一次任務，隨著局勢愈加緊張，芬巴必須在暴露自己祕密身分和保護鎮民之間做出抉擇

programme.title: 潛艦追緝
programme.desc: 被法國海軍封為地表最強千里耳的尚特雷，以超敏銳的聽覺讓海軍弟兄們免於無數次的潛艦危機在敘利亞海域的任務中，卻出現他此生從未聽過也無法分辨的聲軌，隨著聲音漸漸逼近，竟讓潛艦暴露了行蹤，引爆了深海危機；與此同時，法國與俄羅斯的國際情勢逐漸上漲，竟有一顆核彈朝向法國而來，即將成為引爆第三次世界大戰的導火線！

programme.title: 環遊世界大冒險
programme.desc: 這是史上最傳奇的冒險故事，英勇的麥哲倫與意外結識的艾爾卡諾毅然踏上環遊世界的旅程，並從此改變了歷史兩人帶領船隊經過了各個大陸島嶼，在遙遠神秘的島嶼發現了珍貴的香料和稀奇古怪的動植物，也經歷許多生死一瞬間的危險，面對飢餓暴風雨充滿敵意的原始部落，究竟麥哲倫能否成功環繞世界一周，顛覆人們的傳統觀念呢？

programme.title: 311：東京大震盪
programme.desc: 2011年3月11日，日本遭遇史上最大地震的襲擊，引發福島海嘯災難亞歷珊卓拉剛從法國來到東京，正準備在當地法商銀行工作，卻突然遭逢這場核災危機在工作與家庭間拉扯，逐漸浮現的恐懼與焦慮就要吞噬亞歷珊卓拉離開或者留下，丈夫兒女與仰賴她的員工，亞歷珊卓拉該如何抉擇？

programme.title: 殲滅戰1941
programme.desc: 改編自二戰哈薩克名人阿迪沙里波夫的真實故事阿迪沙里波夫中尉與他的軍團在敵軍戰線的包圍下撤退未知的恐懼襲來，他們意識到毫不作為的等待將會比敵人的子彈更加致命

programme.title: 鎖命佈局
programme.desc: 門羅家族是有權有勢的上流家族某天，大家長突然逝世，並留下鉅額遺產然而在分配遺產時，女兒蘿倫卻只分到一萬美金與一個牛皮紙袋，紙袋中裝有一把鑰匙，以及父親生前所錄下的一段影片，並告訴她：有些秘密，必須要帶入墳墓在好奇心的驅使之下，蘿倫用那把鑰匙打開了庭院的鐵門

programme.title: 死神騎馬來
programme.desc: 十五年前的梅斯塔牧場，比爾一家人慘遭搶匪集團滅門，只有小比爾被一名晚到搶匪藏於馬車下而逃過一劫親眼目睹家人慘死的比爾，多年來苦練槍法一心復仇，在追查的過程中遇上甫出獄的中年牛仔瑞恩，兩人似乎有著共同的目標，帶著既像競爭又像合作的方式將匪徒逐一揪出擊斃，而比爾也漸漸發現瑞恩其實隱藏著一段秘密

programme.title: 整鬼專家
programme.desc: 一個香港公共屋邨居民李老太身故，在頭七回魂之夜，李老太鬼魂出現上了孫兒身，欲向兒媳李氏夫婦報仇，幸得捉鬼大師Leon，收服李老太的鬼魂，而Leon之高妙手法，更令少女阿群為之傾心但Leon被認為是一個精神病患者，被重光精神病院職員捉回關在院內，阿群把Leon帶出病院，趕回屋邨收拾殘局

programme.title: 猛龍過江
programme.desc: 武功高強的唐龍，受朋友所託遠赴歐洲協助解決一家餐館的業權問題，遇上黑幫搗亂及威迫，並恥笑中國拳術，唐大怒出手把洋人打得抱頭鼠竄，黑幫首領大為震怒，最後請來美國國際空手道冠軍，與唐龍決一死戰

programme.title: 吊人索
programme.desc: 退休警官杰德庫柏來到西部購買一批牲口準備務農，卻被一群以退役上尉威爾遜為首自稱為民除害的槍手，指控其謀殺及偷竊牛隻，而私下對他處以絞刑庫柏瀕死之際被經過的法警救下，而真實的犯案者也在事後被逮，法官除還庫柏清白外，更力邀庫柏重回警職擔任警長，成為美國西部聯邦法警庫柏決心整治濫用私刑問題為嫌犯爭取公平審判，並將那班原欲吊死他的惡徒一一繩之以法

programme.title: 超級中國龍
programme.desc: 朱事丁是電子遊戲機迷，某日撿到一張來歷不明的電腦光碟，竟與哥哥朱事文雙雙被吸入電腦遊戲－黃金島歷險記的世界中，兩兄弟不但身處黃金島，更誤闖進島主小龍和海盜船長的鬥爭中

programme.title: 摩斯拉
programme.desc: 因為在輻射汙染區發生船難，而意外發現原以為是無人島的神秘小島：嬰兒島當調查隊在島上遭遇危險時，幸得到兩名身高只有30公分的小美人搭救，然而貪婪的人類卻將之捉走並公開表演嬰兒島上的守護神摩斯拉前往日本搭救，人類動用原子熱能砲射擊在東京鐵塔下結繭的摩斯拉，原以為已成功消滅時，摩斯拉卻破繭而出，展動雙翅

programme.title: 巴頓將軍
programme.desc: 二戰中期，當德軍元帥沙漠之狐隆美爾橫掃北非之際，為了扭轉局勢，美方指派巴頓接任英美聯軍的美軍指揮官這位治軍嚴謹特立獨行的將軍，一舉將隆美爾趕出北非，造成德國極大的震撼；然而巴頓藐視命令為求勝仗不顧部下死活的行事風格，在日後的西西里戰役造成盟軍極大傷亡才獲得慘勝，隨即遭到解職然爾後戰事逆轉，盟軍統帥艾森豪只得再次啟用這位德軍剋星重返戰場，解救友軍直搗柏林

programme.title: 卓婭：游擊女英雄
programme.desc: 1941年秋天，高中畢業的卓婭主動申請參加游擊隊在一次任務中，她的戰友遭遇埋伏，她被納粹抓走在忍受數小時的嚴刑逼供後，她仍拒絕透露任何會出賣其他游擊隊的情報她甚至沒告訴敵方她的真實名字卓婭的犧牲並非徒然，她點燃了數百萬人心中的火焰，成為二戰時期無私的英雄象徵她是那個時代最為世人所稱道的英雄

programme.title: 上帝創造女人
programme.desc: 有著一身性感身材但行為放蕩的孤兒茱麗葉，面對著即將被迫送回孤兒院之際，麥克爾卻突然宣告要與她結婚婚後的她依舊按耐不住過去的浪蕩生活，加上與前情人兼麥克爾大哥安東尼朝夕相處，終究還是踰越兩人之間的倫理關係

programme.title: 廟街十二少
programme.desc: 他沒有姓名，人們都稱他十二少，因為他有十二個叱吒黑白兩道的乾爹乾媽，表面上他是天之驕子，但他的內心比誰都寂寞某天，十二少遇見一個改變他一生的女人霍德蘭，他們是兩個極端世界的人，但一段真摯浪漫的愛情偏偏在他們之間發生

programme.title: 獨行鐵金鋼
programme.desc: 在亞利桑那州印地安原住民保護區派尤特郡，無視紀律如牛仔般風流粗暴的鐵血副警長庫根，被派往紐約押解通緝犯林格曼回鄉受審來到事事講求法律人權的紐約大都會，庫根總顯得格格不入林格曼因毒癮發作被關押在戒護監獄，冗長的法律作業程序，讓不耐久候的庫根決定假借法官與紐約警方名義逕行將林格曼帶出監獄，卻在上機前被其同夥偷襲劫走受傷的庫根若空手而回將顏面無光，於是單槍匹馬開始在紐約市裡追捕逃犯！

programme.title: 祭旗
programme.desc: 張山，中校退伍後，擔任大樓夜間保全他有一群死忠好兄弟，每年總會在飛行殉職的兄弟李映川忌日聚會張山帶著妻子與會，不料妻子因車禍殞命，張山則失去記憶兄弟想盡各種法子幫張山找回記憶，最後八個大男人，決定為張山展開一場有趣的環島旅程在雞飛狗跳的過程中，兄弟們彷彿回到過去，與張山一起重生

programme.title: 大洪荒
programme.desc: 公元前百萬年的遠古時代，高原洞穴中的岩石部落，首領阿可荷巴的次子托馬克因不服父親搶奪自己的食物而遭驅逐，流浪至海邊被較文明的貝殼族所救他因奮勇擊退巨獸而為貝殼族所擁戴，並受該族美女羅安納仰慕，而後率領貝殼族人歷經千辛萬苦回到岩石部落，卻人事已非其兄長沙卡納謀害父親並繼任成為新的首領，而高原上的火山也即將爆發

programme.title: 放牛班足球隊
programme.desc: 瑪麗娜是位相當不尋常的修女，她來到一所學校任職，學校收容許多單親失親的孩子她被分配到最不喜歡讀書的放牛班，孩子們一如既往地調皮搗蛋，想要逼退瑪麗娜修女儘管如此，瑪麗娜有個想法，想組建一支足球隊，幫助孩子們找到學習的重心

programme.title: 狄仁傑之四大天王
programme.desc: 狄仁傑大破神都龍王案，獲御賜亢龍鐧，並掌管大理寺，使他成為武則天走向權力之路最大的威脅同時，洛陽城發生諸多離奇事件面對空前危機，狄仁傑要如何保住亢龍鐧？

programme.title: 中秋特映電影-開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: 歷史系教師康森貴（黃百鳴飾）的前世開心鬼朱秀才一直陰魂不散地跟隨著康左右，康女友安妮（楊寶玲飾）的表哥（曹查理飾）對安妮情有獨鐘，視康為眼中釘；但康有朱的暗中保護，常常化險為夷，笑料連篇清兵元帥楊喪昆（劉洵飾）因對一良家女子（貌似安妮）起了邪念，被推下山崖，死在洞中；青年學生Behind組合（Beyond）在一次意外中將他的盔甲帶回學校，誰知他的鬼魂附於盔甲上，從此學校亂成一團

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: Bonjour麵包店
programme.desc: 車勝元金宣虎金喜愛強強聯手！全韓首間銀髮族專屬療癒咖啡廳 開幕當頂級影星遇上銀髮族長輩，一場最療癒的化學反應即將發生！Bonjour麵包店 將場景搬移至寧靜鄉村，打造全韓首間專屬長者的咖啡廳這裡不只販售甜點，更分享故事由金喜愛金宣虎組成超暖心服務組，用溫柔對話與親切笑容治癒每位長輩；廚房則由萬能主廚車勝元攜手李基澤，將在地食材化作精緻藝術品看這群大咖藝人如何陪伴長者細數人生軌跡，在麵包香氣中傳遞溫暖

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 熱血軍檢首
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 熱血軍檢
programme.desc: 安普賢攜手曹寶兒，成最強軍檢察官搭檔！！以韓國軍事法庭為背景，為了各自目的而成為軍檢察官，都培萬只想往上爬達成復仇目標，車友仁出身軍法世家，為替父母討回公道而回到軍中當軍中黑暗勢力浮上檯面，他們選擇不再服從命令，而是直面權力揭露真相在正義與復仇之間，兩人逐步找回真正的信念，也點燃危險又炙熱的同盟關係，從對立到並肩作戰的故事

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚不折不撓的品性宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 夫婦的世界升級版！初戀女神現身 揭開五人幫隱藏面具一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學五人幫維持二十年的體面假象死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失嫉妒的丈夫被逼到絕境的妻子病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 裸婚時代
programme.desc: 八年愛情遇上現實 婚後生活秒變修羅場劉易陽與童佳倩相戀八年，決定在懷孕之際不顧家境懸殊與雙方父母的強烈反對，選擇沒房沒車沒鑽戒沒婚禮的裸婚兩人原以為愛情足以抵擋現實，但婚後卻發現，與易陽父母同住的壓力兩家價值觀的衝突，以及柴米油鹽的重擔正逐步侵蝕他們的浪漫當理想被生活逼到牆角，這對一路走來的戀人，究竟能否守住最初的承諾，為愛打下一個真正的家？

programme.title: 優雅的朋友們
programme.desc: 夫婦的世界升級版！初戀女神現身 揭開五人幫隱藏面具一場離奇猝死與密室謀殺，撕裂大學五人幫維持二十年的體面假象死黨萬植離世，失蹤多年的初戀海淑突然現身，喚醒男人們被西裝掩蓋的慾望與罪惡模範人夫宮哲察覺妻子靜海疑似出軌，威脅她的教練卻隨即身亡，監視器與證物一夜消失嫉妒的丈夫被逼到絕境的妻子病態迷戀的死黨，誰在說謊？當祕密層層揭開，每個人都是嫌疑犯，誰才是最終的殺人兇手？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.title: 我要做廚神 : 澳洲篇英

programme.desc: 方中信和陳錦鴻是黑社會雇用的殺手,陳性格放蕩,喜結異性,並將已為人婦的周海媚搞上手.方早已提醒他,不要死在女人手上.果然,周投靠了黑社會大佬方平,將他倆出賣.方,陳被仇家追殺,陳在逃亡時重傷至精神失常,只靠方獨力照顧.正當二人從未如此親近過時,仇家臨門,兩兄弟再次同心合力,拼命殺出生路...

programme.title: 邪Mall粵

programme.title: 猜猜我是誰普
programme.desc: 以社會話題的電話詐騙案為題材,阿海與阿芳經營一個跨越中港泰三地的詐騙集團,集團擁有大量銀行卡及客戶資料,中港兩地遍佈提取現金的網絡,只要設在泰國的總部打出電話,幾萬至幾十萬的詐騙金在數十分鐘內即可滾滾而來.為了對付這個龐大的詐騙集團,警方設立了一個反詐騙的專案小組,以電腦科技追蹤詐騙金下落.女特警小兔混入遠在泰國的詐騙集團,而警員丁小田與小兔裡應外合,專案組與詐騙集團展開層層緊扣的反詐智鬥,...

programme.title: 風雨同路粵
programme.desc: 身為匪幫首領的大膽成奎安飾,策劃了偷取鑽石南非鑽皇的大案,並找來了江湖中人李雲飛陳惠敏飾協助鑽石交易.但李雲飛意外地破壞了交易大計,使大膽憤怒,決定追殺李雲飛.警方的李Sir李修賢飾委派了臥底張郎周星馳飾跟着李雲飛搜證,並找來吳Sir吳少雄飾協助他與張郎.但吳Sir對張郎並無好感,屢屢向張郎施加壓力,與此同時張郎又發現李雲飛的感情生活與他相似,兩人產生交情,使他陷入兩難.

programme.title: 竊聽風雲粵普
programme.desc: 香港刑事情報科和商業罪案調查科合作查緝風華國際上市公司中的洗錢,詐騙,非法操控股價等商業罪案,調查科主管黃福榮下令要先從三大股東徐偉,費國雄和羅耀明身上調查.竊聽三人組阿俊,老楊與小祥共同潛入風華國際辦公室安裝多數高端竊聽器和監視器,在公司對面大樓的據點開始輪班形式的監視竊聽工作,記錄下三大股東的所有對話內容,會談對象,以及金錢交易.而老楊和小祥於一天夜裏監視到羅耀明陪他的秘書兼女友林綺...

programme.title: 愛情Amoeba粵普
programme.desc: 阿東,阿郎和BRAD是同住在一起的室友,與他們住在一塊的還有他們都把她當成兄弟的李蕙敏,影片的故事就發生在這幾個年輕人身上.阿東有個相戀多年的女友,但長期一成不變的愛情生活使兩人變得麻木,直到阿東遇上了表妹吳辰君,他的生活才開始多姿多彩,但這時湯寶如却又表示出對他的深愛,令阿東左右爲難...

programme.title: 城市獵人粵
programme.desc: 孟波成龍飾,綽號城市獵人,是一位私家偵探.過去曾有一位搭檔中村王敏德客串,然而中村在一次單獨出任務時失手,臨死前將妹妹惠香王祖賢飾託付給孟波,並囑咐孟波不可以泡她.長大以後的惠香卻遠超過孟波當初的認知,讓孟波很後悔當初答應中村不泡惠香惠香成為孟波的助手,兩人的關係相當曖昧.日本報業大王今村宏次荻原賢三飾的獨生女今村清子後藤久美子飾離家出走,今村宏次得知女兒去了香...

programme.title: 黑獄斷腸歌之砌生豬肉粵普
programme.desc: 六十年代的香港,警隊貪污嚴重.記者程安,在文章爆警察貪污內幕,得罪了華探張耀祖,祖砌安生豬肉,令安含冤入獄.監獄的保安主任常以殘酷手段對付不服從的人.安真相寫成專稿,偷運出獄外爆大鑊,安從此成了眾人心目中的大英雄...

programme.title: 最佳福星粵

programme.title: 榕樹頭講鬼粵普
programme.desc: 出生豪門的施富貴,戀上名妓如花,無奈世俗難容,兩人被逼分開,施更被逐出家門,憤而投江自盡,化成冤鬼遊魂,四處找尋如花蹤影.數十年後,施重遊舊地,纏上了明,濂,SUE,CAT四人,更要求她們幫忙尋找如花,在尋找過程中,人鬼建立了深厚的情誼...

programme.title: 重口味粵普

Mastermind: 1977
programme.desc: Magnus Magnusson hosts the eighth heat of the quiz from Cardiff University, with four contenders answering questions on the specialist subjects of the Mahrattas and their wars 1657-1848, the Zulu War of 1879, Mary, Queen of Scots and General Robert E Lee

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson hosts as Frank Muir, Ciaran Madden and Colin Morris take on Arthur Marshall, Penelope Keith and Donald Sinden in the game of word definitions and deceptions. First broadcast in 1980

programme.title: Mary Moore Remembers - Henry Moore
programme.desc: Ahead of an evening of programmes marking 40 years since the death of the great British sculptor, his daughter Mary looks back on her fathers life, work and relationship with TV and its audiences. She explains how Moore felt that encouraging the public to develop an awareness and appreciation of sculpture was a vital part of his role as Britains most internationally renowned artist, and how documentaries and TV interviews were key to that mission. She also shares her memories of growing up in the family home in Hertfordshire, a space that is now open to the public as part of the Henry Moore Studios Gardens, and how being surrounded by great, important, and hugely valuable works of art was just part of everyday life for her as a young girl

programme.title: Henry Moore: A Culture Show Special
programme.desc: A 2010 programme in which Alan Yentob examines the sculptors life on film, looking at how his appearances on programmes such as Monitor, Face to Face, The Ascent of Man and Nationwide helped his rise to fame after the Second World War and allowed his radical and progressive art to be accepted. He meets BBC producer John Read, whose 1951 profile of Moore was the first full-length documentary about a living artist, and looks at the man behind the media image as he talks to Moores daughter Mary and fans such as Antony Gormley and Anish Kapoor

programme.title: Henry Moore: Monitor
programme.desc: In an interview from 1960, Huw Wheldon visits the sculptor at his home in the run-up to a major exhibition of his work at the Whitechapel Gallery in London

programme.title: Henry Moore at Home
programme.desc: Tony Church narrates a programme from 1974 in which the sculptor talks about his fascination with sheep and their ancient biblical quality and also discusses in detail several of his sculptures. He also talks about the collection of paintings and sculptures he has at his home and studios, including a Cezanne painting, Degas drawings and several statues from ancient cultures

programme.title: Henry Moore: Face to Face
programme.desc: An interview from 1960 in which the sculptor talks to John Freeman about his much-loved father, his inspirational school art teacher, and how much he hates working to commission. The interview takes place in Moores home in Perry Green, Hertfordshire.

programme.title: Ancient Worlds
programme.desc: Archaeologist and historian Richard Miles examines the collapse of the Bronze Age 3,000 years ago, and how the civilisations of the subsequent Iron Age emerged. He explores the former Phoenician cities of Byblos and Tyre and their technological contributions, including the alphabet and deep-water sailing, before heading to Israel to learn how the Assyrian war machine affected small local powers

programme.title: Britains Lost Masterpieces
programme.desc: British art detectives Bendor Grosvenor and Emma Dabiri hunt for of the nations great lost masterpieces. They uncover if a painting of a society woman is by artist Joshua Reynolds and discover which celebrity playwright will lead them from Rome to Bath to Londons Royal Academy

programme.title: Autumn: Earths Seasonal Secrets
programme.desc: How animals and plants deal with the changes in the environment that occur every autumn. As summer ends, animals have to prepare for the winter ahead. Chipmunks and beavers hurry to hoard their winter supplies before the weather grows colder, while musk oxen and beetles find they only have one more chance to mate before the year is out and young gannets face the first dangerous challenge of their lives. Narrated by Andrew Scott

programme.title: Erpa
programme.desc: Journalist Ruairidh Macivers 2024 film, marking 10 years of sobriety. He reflecting on the effect alcohol and drugs have had on his life, as well as his journey through recovery

programme.title: Trusadh: Mo Bheatha, Mo Bhodhaig
programme.desc: From social media filters to algorithm-driven ideals, appearance has become public - judged and endlessly measured. Lauren McDonald explores body image, sharing her own story and meeting others who open up about their personal highs and lows

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Pearl Phoenix
programme.desc: In Huangmei Opera tradition, this movie tells the love story of Wen, who sells himself as a slave to a rich family, and Huo, the familys young daughter. The lovers are kept apart by Huos stepmother and Huo escapes by dressing up as a man. Wen is framed and put into jail so Huo has to go back and rescue her lover!

programme.title: Love With The Perfect Stranger
programme.desc: After breaking up with his girlfriend, salesman Bao meets a rich girl, Jin Jin, who just broke up with her boyfriend. Two equally heartbroken strangers fall in love instantly and get married on impulse. The couple lives happily together until Jin Jin finds herself pregnant with her ex-boyfriends baby...

programme.title: The Jade Raksha
programme.desc: A fearsome swordswoman known as The Jade Raksha appears in the martial arts world and begins killing people whose surname is Yan. A swordsman figures out who she is and asks her why. Apparently a Yan killed her family 18 years ago and she only has vengeance on her mind...

programme.title: The Mad Monk Strikes Again
programme.desc: The Living Buddha Ji Gong and the immortal Lu Dong Bin descend to the mortal world, where the fates of several women spark a rivalry. As the two deities showcase their powers in three bizarre contests, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds. Amid romantic entanglements, an epic battle between immortals and mortals begins.

programme.title: Young Vagabond
programme.desc: Su Can, the carefree yet unruly eldest son of a winery owner, is forced to study under a tutor after being expelled from school. He soon discovers that his tutor is a martial arts master and becomes his disciple. However, when his family and master are slain by the ruthless bandit, Centipede, Su Can embarks on a perilous quest for revenge.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: The Lovers Blades, a pair of invincible weapons, are to be delivered to the Qing Emperor. However, they accidentally fell into the hands of Xiao Zhong Hui and Yuan Guan Nan, so Imperial Chief Zhuo Tian Xiong hunts them down for the blades. As the battle begins, the secret of the blades are also revealed.

programme.title: Swift Sword
programme.desc: A righteous swordsman, Bai Yi Pang, seeks revenge on an evil clan but is crippled after being beaten up by them. Years later, a young man encounters Bai who is hiding in a cave. Bai decides to teach this determined young man his Swift Sword skills so that he can help Bai take revenge on the evil clan.

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his fathers death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Longs wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident...

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brothers death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: River of Tears
programme.desc: Retired singer Fang lives happily with her husband and son. Tragedy happens when a man from her past returns to haunt her. In an ensuing struggle to free her from his clutches, her husband dies in a car accident. Blamed by her father-in-law for her husbands death, Fang gets chased out of the house and goes back to singing to make a living...

programme.title: Heaven Sword and Dragon Sabre 2
programme.desc: Only by bringing together the powerful Heaven Sword and the mighty Dragon Sabre can six martial arts sects struggling for supremacy be saved in this thrilling sequel to Chu Yuans original hit.

programme.title: The Happiest Moment
programme.desc: This erotic comedy anthology features three stories about an old man who dies from an overdose of virility pills, a cop who goes on the run after extorting money from a hooker, and a barbers apprentice who encounters a lively corpse in a night vigil. Through playing all these characters, Michael Hui proves himself as a genius of Hong Kong comedy.

programme.title: Asia-pol
programme.desc: Asiapol agent Yang Ming Xuan trails a shipment of contraband gold being delivered to gang leader, George Eaton. He enlists the help of a Chinese woman who is trying to avenge her sister and narrowly escapes several deadly traps as he closes in on Eatons location. This spy film is loosely inspired by the James Bond movies.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.title: The Flying Mr. B
programme.desc: Mr. Shi, a secondary PE teacher, accidentally takes a super pill invented by the science teacher and gains superpower, turning into Mr. B. He uses his superpower to help the school sports team win the championship and prevent crimes. When the triad is made aware of Mr. Bs superpower, they try to gain the super pill for nefarious purposes.

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Lolanto, a playboy, is injured and meets the daughter of a tycoon, Man, in the hospital. Man is mentally retarded and makes friends easily with Lolanto hence Mans father hires him to take care of her. However, as Man goes through treatments and recovers, her feelings for Lolanto also changes

programme.title: Blind War
programme.desc: Former SWAT captain Dong Gu suffers traumatic visual loss during a failed mission for which he is forced to take responsibility. He manages to get over and adapt to the situation with his daughters company, until his nemesis appears and puts his daughter in danger. Despite being blind, Dong Gu must fight to save his daughter.

programme.title: Love in a Fallen City
programme.desc: Based on a novel of the same name by the famous novelist Eileen Chang and directed by the equally acclaimed director Ann Hui, this romance story depicts the challenging relationship between an introverted Shanghai divorcee and a cynical Malaysian playboy during the Japanese invasion of Hong Kong in the 1940s. Will the lovers be together in the end?

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: My School Mate, The Barbarian
programme.desc: Edward attends a new school which has a reputation for fighting. Student leader Stone, befriends Edward, but their friendship is tested when a local triad leader discovers that Edward comes from a wealthy family.

programme.title: Turns We Take
programme.desc: A spicy hot pot restaurant in Northeast China serves different types of customers every day. Amongst them are a sweet young couple, two wayward young men and a taxi driver. Despite being complete strangers to each other, their lives are intertwined by a traffic accident

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: Drunken Master

When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Mahjong Heroes
programme.desc: A hero helps a young student deflect a cunning and malicious gambling tycoon who is out to take over the students family business over a game of mahjong.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles

The keys lie in the hands of Sams wife, a ruthless kingpin and a righteous cop.

When his wife grows suspicious, she hires his close friend, private investigator Bong, to uncover the truth. As the plot unravels, Lau escalates his schemes to silence all threats, leading to a deadly showdown between former friends.

The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

Meanwhile, renowned magician Cheung Yin arrives to perform for Lui, while secretly plotting to rescue Lau Yiu and avenge the tragedy that destroyed his family years ago.

programme.title: Iceman

Four hundred years later, they awaken in modern Hong Kong, where they must reignite their ancient feud in a world they can barely recognise.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic message in a bottle sends Taiwanese girl Ah Bu on a quest to Hong Kong to find its author, Albert. Disheartened when he turns out to be nothing like she imagined, she prepares to return home. However, her plans take an unexpected turn when she encounters Chan, a wealthy tycoon, and an unlikely romance begins to bloom.

programme.desc: In this sequel, the four imperial guards are defrosted and reanimated in modern Hong Kong. Driven by a single goal to obtain the Golden Wheel of Time and right the wrongs of the past, Ying embarks on a perilous quest, unaware that every step draws him deeper into a deadly trap.

programme.desc: When a pesky gopher gets in the way of Fawna making her famous veggie stew, Niah learns to not let a bad experience, get in the way of doing good. When the inexperienced Rona has to step in for Donna, the team makes sure everyone has the best camping trip ever.

programme.title: Power Outage Part 3 4
programme.desc: Power Outage Part 3: Escape from Scare School Things worsen when a leprechaun, Razznik, steals the magical cleptor that now holds all of Scare Schools powers. Power Outage Part 4: The Final Battle On a hunt for ghostly powers, the evil leprechaun orders Deedstown to hand over Caspers uncles, OR ELSE.

programme.title: Ghost In The Gallery Wart On The Nose
programme.desc: Ghost in the Gallery After hearing reports of a ghost stealing artwork from the Deedstown Museum, Casper becomes convinced that his uncles are involved. Wart on the Nose When Professor Thurdigree Burns comes down with dragon flu, Casper, Mantha and Ra are tasked with finding a cure.

programme.title: Abra-CAT-Dabra
programme.desc: Baby Box is learning to be a great magician and wants to pull a rabbit out of a hat. But when theres no rabbit to be found, Gabby, Pandy and Baby Box visit the other Gabby Cats for help. For the COTD, Baby Box, Gabby and Pandy sing the Whoopsies! Song.

programme.title: The Fly-A-Long Unburied Treasure
programme.desc: When the Dews Glitter Guide, Willow comes to check on the Dews progress, they feel like theyre failing to impress her, until Lola gets locked out of the apartment during a game of Hide-and-Seek and Dews work together to get her back inside. When the Dew Drops discover a time capsule in the park, they set out to find the mystery owner.

programme.title: Tooth on the Loose That Thing You Dew
programme.desc: When Phoebe convinces the Tooth Fairy to visit before Marcus has actually lost his tooth, the Dew Drops do everything in their power to make sure the tooth is out before she arrives! The Dews decide to hold a concert in the park for their animal friends, but cant find the time to practice.

programme.title: She Said, She Said Starfish
programme.desc: When one of Rikkis plants wont sing, Pixie and Juniper both tell their varying recollections of why the plant is suddenly silent. Kelp, Scallop, and Cruz have always thought that starfish did nothing but laze about but as they go about their day, the starfish goes through his own routine, completely unbeknownst to everyone else.

programme.title: Leroys Caterpillar Lost Spark
programme.desc: Leroy must learn to let go when his caterpillar friend turns into a butterfly. When Pixie loses her spark, Kelp and Juniper look for the plant they think will cure her. Meanwhile Pixie wonders whether she can be cured at all!

programme.title: Mom for a Day Kitty in the City
programme.desc: When Mom is sick on a busy day at home, Tag offers to pick up the slack and take on her tasks for the day. Tag handles it at first, but when the responsibilities start to stack up, she realizes that being Mom is much harder than she thought. Tag and Scooch are excited to get to know Kit, who has organized a bunch of cat-ivities for the day. But when Kit realizes she accidentally scratched up Frank and Beanss tree, she, Tag and Scooch find a way to make it up to them.

programme.title: The Itch To Switch Mismatched Socks
programme.desc: When Tag is frustrated living in a crowded house, and Scooch is bored in a quiet house, the two friends switch houses for the day. At first they both love their new lives. But as Scooch gets overwhelmed by all the activity at The Barker house, and Tag gets bored by the quiet life at the Poochs, they eagerly switch back before the day is done. When the Pawston Get Sox go on a losing streak, Tag and Scooch come up with the idea to have a team mascot. And Frank and Beans are the perfect fit! But

programme.title: Mecha-Menace
programme.desc: Magnus and Axel unveil their new mechano-dragon. Its impressive at first, but the Riders set out to prove its no better than a bucket of bolts.

programme.title: Summer Holiday
programme.desc: In need of some rest and relaxation, the Riders head out on vacation. But their supposedly perfect island getaway isnt quite what they hoped for.

programme.title: The Year of The Lion
programme.desc: During the Lunar New Year festival, Alex is bummed to learn that theres no Year of the Lion. Determined to be somebody important, he sets out to become the star of the festival by taking on the role of the Dragon- but he eventually learns that every role has importance, and realizes the costume that fits him best is his own fur.

programme.title: A Frog-let Tale
programme.desc: Lala, whos grown into a froglet, is ready to finally join the gang on a big adventure in the city! But she relies on her water bowl to get around, and Gloria goes overboard in trying to protect her tiny friend in the big world- only to realize that she underestimated all Lala is capable of doing.

programme.title: Pariah: Sonny Liston
programme.desc: Was Sonny Liston murdered? programme.title: 爱的勘探法Exploration Method of Love

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australias best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 2
programme.desc: Steer clear of these alphas, whose horns, claws, and other protective gear keep them ready for battle, no matter what the weather dishes out. Examine killer Highland cow horns, plucky mallard bills, razor-edged wolverine claws, and more.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1

programme.title: Wild Science Season 1

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1

programme.title: 盗月者The Moon Thieves
programme.desc: 一家贼赃手表店的老板策划一组盗窃团队，成员包括大贼爆破专家开锁天才和二手表专家，飞往东京盗取三只名贵手表然而，当他们偶然发现了更珍贵的手表Moonwatch后，行动起了变化，被日本黑帮追杀他们必须合作力图脱身，并把手表带回香港

programme.title: 望月Once in a Blue Moon
programme.desc: 美珍的家庭表面看似和睦，实则每个人都隐藏着秘密美珍在工作中遭遇经理的无理对待，弟弟与妻子分居，却在家人面前假装恩爱，而母亲仍对多年前一件导致丈夫离去的事情感到遗憾中秋将至，这一家人能否抚平伤口，重新检视家庭和团聚的真正意义？

programme.title: 长江七号CJ7

programme.title: 一秒钟One Second
programme.desc: 著名导演张艺谋执导，叙述文化大革命期间被送往劳改营的平民，为找女儿在电影中新闻报导一秒钟出现了的菲林，不惜从劳改营逃走一路上，他遇上一个孤女，二人同样要找到那卷电影菲林最后平民可否将菲林顺利交给电影放映员，让电影在大屏幕播出？

programme.title: 加害者被害者Victims
programme.desc: 一名凶残的吉隆坡高中生杀害了同班同学，随着受害者的母亲与凶手的母亲揭开自己儿子隐藏的秘密，她们各自陷入截然不同的痛苦与挣扎之中，更一步步逼近令人心碎的真相

programme.title: 一闪一闪亮星星Shining for One Thing
programme.desc: 张万森计划在高考后向暗恋已久的女生林北星表白，突如其来的意外事故却让一切变成了一场无可挽回的悲剧没想到的是，痛苦无助的张万森竟意外地再次回到了悲剧发生前林北星的身边他这次能否弥补过去以表歉意？

programme.title: 把幸福拉近一点Wish Comes True
programme.desc: 被母亲抛弃但依然性格开朗的少女小菲，偶遇身患罕见病症才华横溢的年轻男子子威，两人因此结下不解之缘小菲决心帮助子威寻回失去的爱人，过程中却发现子威长期等待的治疗新药竟无效尽管遭受沉重打击，两人依然决心携手，用爱与希望点亮彼此的生命

programme.title: 失衡凶间Tales from the Occult
programme.desc: 电影由三个发生于城市森林暗黑角落的诡异短篇故事组成年轻歌手搬到新居后，感到有灵异生物在角落，导致抑郁症复发；一位网红来到商场表演，最后却变成一场死亡直播；唐楼租客连手对抗楼梯出现的神秘怪客

programme.title: 秘密访客Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: 一场惨烈的校车车祸，导致几乎全部学童丧生司机拼命救回一名男孩，却令自己失去部分记忆男孩的父亲为答救命之恩，把司机带到自家地下室里与他们共同生活司机渐渐发现这家人的行为诡秘，众人的异常更似乎与那场车祸有关

programme.title: 困兽Death Stranding
programme.desc: 为了整顿已经纷乱不堪的地下博彩业，警方联合博彩协会展开打击地下赌场的严厉行动，并将新建赌场经营权以拍卖的形式处理，重新整顿博彩业由于不一样的拍卖引发赌城风云变迁，不为人知的利益和秘密跟着被揭露，更引起各方人马的冲突

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 爱的勘探法Exploration Method of Love
programme.desc: 本该在野外探勘的地质学博士苏纪时，因为双胞胎妹妹苏瑾不辞而别引发的职业危机，暂时回来顶替妹妹上岗成为艺人苏瑾先前和穆氏集团总裁穆休伦有情侣合约的协议，苏纪时在忙着提防身份被揭穿的同时，还需履行与穆休伦的假情侣合约，两人在情感中你来我往，暧昧上头

programme.title: 爱情有烟火Love Has Fireworks
programme.desc: Qian Fei receives Shanlifangs lawyer letter. Dang Yu apologizes online but is attacked Dajun publicly supports her. Li Yifei lifts Qian Feis spirits with a makeover.

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: Over the course of recorded time, many species have been threatened with extinction. Once-powerful animal empires like the dinosaurs - have been completely wiped from the planet. But others once on the verge of disappearance have survived, bounced back, and even reclaimed their kingdoms.

programme.title: The Living Beach Season 1
programme.desc: Its a UNESCO World Heritage Site, the largest sand island on earth, and home to wild dingoes, six-foot sand-worms, and eucalyptus woodlands. Find out how everything lives happily together in a complex ecosystem built entirely upon sand.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Despite being one of Australias best-known marsupials, koalas live only in the east and southeast parts of the continent. Learn how their lives and behaviors vary in these different regions.

programme.title: Secret Life of the Koala Season 1
programme.desc: Koalas may seem solitary and inert, but mating season brings a dramatic shift in their behavior, leading to movement, contact, and conflict. As breeding season begins, follow two large males on a mission to mate.

programme.title: Africas Wild Year Season 1
programme.desc: Summer in Africa is a season of extremes, it separates the weak from the strong. It tests the survival instincts of cheetahs, lions, geckos, turtles and many more species as they search for food and water in the extreme heat of summer.

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1
programme.desc: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

programme.title: Battle of the Alphas Season 2
programme.desc: Check out some fancy footwork and killer alpha moves. Catch a male brown hare throwing punches at his beloved, admire a sandhill crane dance battle, watch ibexes butt heads literally during mating season, and see why leopards are stealth masters.

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1
programme.desc: Bask in the interconnected lives of wildlife shaped by volcanoes, forests, and seas. Take flight with rare Philippine eagles as they raise their young in an ancient tree, then dive into a river to catch a glimpse of the worlds rarest crocodile.

programme.title: Wild Philippines Season 1
programme.desc: Plunge into crystal-clear seas to explore the Tubbataha Reef, which rests on an extinct underwater volcano where shallow lagoons shelter sea turtles and tiger sharks. Take flight with tarsiers as they hunt insects using powerful leaps between trees.

programme.title: Guardians of the Wild Season 2
programme.desc: Across Africa 97 of black rhinos have been killed for their horns. In 1997 the species was declared officially extinct in Zambia. But now, thanks to an ambitious reintroduction plan, theyre back. Poaching hasnt gone away their horns are still prized in Asian medicine. But a small, dedicated team are fighting to keep them safe. This is the frontline of conservation it doesnt get any tougher.

programme.title: Zambia Untamed Season 1
programme.desc: In the Luangwa Valley lies a grove of Ebony trees, home to a troop of baboons. But, there are dangers here the resident leopard who, unlike the other predators, is powerful and agile enough to climb trees. Hes not an easy foe to elude.

programme.title: Zambia Untamed Season 1
programme.desc: The plains and woodlands of the Luangwa Valley are the wildest and most merciless of all neighborhoods where duels between predator and prey are played out both day and night. For the animals that call this home, its a daily battle to stay alive.

programme.title: Animal Empires Season 1
programme.desc: As the popular characters of songs and stories, farm animals are celebrated all over the world. But few stories tell of their sister species who live in the wild. These animals known primarily as livestock, beasts of burden, or even pets must fend for themselves beyond the fences of their domesticated kin.

programme.title: The Living Beach Season 1
programme.desc: The beaches of California are some of the most beautiful in the world, but are they falling out of balance due to mankinds effects on nature? What does it take for the magnificent fauna of the Pacific Coast to keep living on the living beach?

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah berada di sebuah kampong, dia baru sedarkan diri akibat kemalangan itu. Kepala Aisyah berdarah teruk sehingga tidak mampu mengingati siapa dirinya. Kini Aisyah tinggal bersama pasangan suami isteri Anim dan Azri serta anak mereka Amani. Mereka telah menjumpai Aisyah yang terbaring di jalan dan telah merawat Aisyah selama Aisyah tidak sedarkan diri selama 3 hari. Aisyah benar-benar tidak dapat mengingati siapa dirinya yang sebenar. Anim telah member nama sementara ingatan Aisyah masih belum pulih dengan nama NUR. Di kampong itu, Aisyah melalui kehidupannya dengan gembira dan apa yang membuatkan dirinya bahagia apabila ada sepasang suami isteri, Rokiah dan Sarip yang mirip akan wajah arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Sementara Iskandar semakin tidak terurus, kesihatannya semakin tidak menentu disebabkan hatinya benar-benar merindui Aisyah. Sudah puas dia mencari Aisyah. Bimbang dengan keadaan itu, Tengku Maria memberitahu perkara sebenar bahawa dia lah punca kehilangan Aisyah. Iskandar memarahi Tengku Maria dengan teruk. programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. programme.title: Keluarga Saranghae
programme.desc: Keluarga Saranghea membawakan kisah Dalam Diam Aku Berjuang dengan tetamu jemputan, Muhammad Fariz Nasrin, seorang aktivis kesedaran kesihatan mental serta guru sastera yang berkongsi pengalaman menghadapi ujian kesihatan mental dihoskan oleh Numan Hani bin Jamal.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Borneo Dive
programme.desc: Borneo Dive 2 will take viewers to experience the beauty of diving sites around Borneo, including Sabah, Sarawak, and Labuan. Join host Baki Zainal as he is accompanied by local celebrities who are also divers.

programme.title: Alunan Borneo
programme.desc: Alunan Borneo, sebuah travelog seorang anak seni untuk mengenali lebih dekat tentang muzikirama tradisi etnik di Bumi Kenyalang dan berkenalan dengan lebih dekat dengan etnik-etnik di Sarawak.

programme.title: Suara Alam Borneo
programme.desc: Suara Alam Borneo akan mengupasnya hutan hujan tropika berusia jutaan tahun secara terperinci dengan pelbagai spesis flora dan juga fauna menerusi informasi yang mudah difahami.

programme.title: 7 Hari Sebelum Mati
programme.desc: Afiq, a young man in Kuala Lumpur, returns to his hometown after a mysterious warning of impending death. He seeks redemption by mending broken relationships and facing his past mistakes within seven days.

programme.desc: TVS Pagi membawakan perkembangan menyeluruh dari dalam dan luar negara.

programme.title: Aroma Malaysia
programme.desc: Aroma Malaysia menampilkan eksplorasi kulinari yang memperkenalkan hidangan tradisional dan tempatan, diperkaya dengan pengalaman pengembaraan merentasi pelbagai destinasi budaya

programme.title: DL World News
programme.desc: Delivers timely and in-depth coverage of key global events, focusing on international politics, economics, and societal changes, with a spotlight on the latest developments impacting the world today.

programme.desc: TVS Fillers delivers quick, engaging segments on Sarawakian culture, local trends, and more, keeping viewers entertained between programs.

programme.title: Be Our Guest
programme.desc: Meet the park rangers, dancers, and homestay hosts who welcome visitors to Sarawaksharing village life, culture, and the warmth that makes the Land of the Hornbill unforgettable.

programme.title: Sarawak Angler

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Jubah Dari Mekah

Shakir tidak bersetuju Abil dikurung, namun tidak mampu mengubah keadaan apabila ibunya terpaksa mendapatkan dadah untuk Abil. Apabila Mak Leha merancang menunaikan umrah, abangnya bersetuju menunaikan ibadah itu bagi menggantikan Abil yang semakin teruk keadaannya.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot

programme.desc: Li Jiading Master Ding, the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

programme.title: Gourmet Express

Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors.
